G3.bolt_diagnosis: M2 is 0.6300 at ALL widths so the fit constant is correct. M1 and M3 DRIFT by viewport. A constant rotateX cannot produce a drifting ratio, therefore the scale-dependent term is the FIXED perspective:1500px: lens distortion scales with the ratio of perspective distance to rendered size. Second cause of M4: fitScene sizes to the RANK FLOOR while stands sit at 1.60x, so they stick out by construction.
